西顶 XIDING · 设计系统展示。本页由仓库里的 design-system/ 生成：令牌、IP 体系、组件、资产和品牌手册都从文件读出，提交即同步。 最近一次改动：v1.8 lifted into source files: the page kit and nine components from v1.7 (Ink, LockupMotion, Photo, Whisper, Export, Go, Lang, FieldBlock, Ecosystem), the source VI of 西頂廣仁宮 as vi-* tokens, the VI asset group and TempleSign; three-locale fonts.

三步

  1. 人和内容带来艺术家和行业专家。
  2. 三个牌子把专家的能力交付给会员和合作伙伴。
  3. 智能体之间完成匹配、预约与分账，收益回到出力的人手里。

TOKENS

令牌

78 个令牌，读自 tokens.json。颜色按主题列出，别名已解开；对比度为在 paper · surface 上的比值。

颜色 27

Three inks: temple teal, black, white. The UI tokens flip between themes; the brand-* tokens stay the same. The ink-* tokens give each of the three brands one ink: 西顶艺术 ink-arts, 西顶学院 ink-academy, 西顶时光 ink-lifestyle. The vi-* tokens (v1.8) are the source VI's six swatches, kept for reference and signage; no component uses them yet.

Assets

AssetKit

Assets960 × 3440

Every asset the system generates, drawn at the moment the page opens: lockups, sub-brand lockups, wordmarks, the three brands as pillars and the business cards.

正在绘制 AssetKit

使用说明

Every asset the system generates, drawn at the moment the page opens: lockups, sub-brand lockups, wordmarks, the three brands as pillars and the business cards. Xiding.kit() returns the list; Xiding.toSVG(art) and Xiding.toPNG(art) turn one entry into a file.

You provide nothing. To add an asset, add it to kit() in components/src/xiding.ts; it then appears here and in the build.

  • One source. Each asset is a list of shapes and type made by the bundle from the mark's points, the brand inks and Xiding.BRAND_DETAILS, Xiding.BRANDS and Xiding.PEOPLE. Change a name, a word or a card detail there and every tile follows.
  • PNG is drawn on a canvas with the page's own fonts, so the type is exact. Lockups export at their source size, cards at 300 dpi with bleed.
  • SVG keeps live text and needs Noto Serif SC and Instrument Sans where it is opened.
  • Files in Assets. Assets that use the serif alone are also stored as outlined SVG files under Wordmarks, Pillars and Cards. They are produced by components/src/build-assets.ts from this same list. Assets that carry the Latin line need Instrument Sans, so they are saved from this page.
  • Save buttons appear where the page is allowed to save files.

Brand

BrandRow

Brand640 × 120

Names joined by the pair dot, the mark's own two overlapping dots used as a separator.

正在绘制 BrandRow

使用说明

Names joined by the pair dot, the mark's own two overlapping dots used as a separator. Xiding.brandRow(['西顶艺术', '西顶学院', '西顶时光'], { size, color }) returns inline HTML that takes the surrounding colour.

You provide the names, in order, and a font size.

  • Use the pair dot wherever two names or two facts sit on one line: sub-brands, a phone number and an email, a date and a place. It replaces the slash, the bullet, the pipe and the middle dot.
  • The pair is drawn from the text size: each dot is 0.19em in radius, centres 1.54 radii apart, with 1.5em of space on each side.
  • On brand-teal, set it at 24px or larger in brand-white; smaller white type on teal falls under 4.5:1.

Brand960 × 350

A pressable tile showing one approved colourway and style of the mark, with its name underneath.

正在绘制 ColorwayTile

使用说明

A pressable tile showing one approved colourway and style of the mark, with its name underneath. Class xd-tile; put Xiding.mark(...) and a <span> inside a <button>.

You provide the colourway, the style and the caption ("Temple teal, dot").

  • Lay tiles four across with space-12 between them, two across on a phone.
  • The chosen tile takes aria-pressed="true": an ink border, doubled by an inset line. The border carries the selection.
  • Captions are caption size, sentence case, colourway first: "Black on white, circle".

Ink

Brand960 × 200

Puts any block on one brand's ink: xd-ink--arts (西顶艺术, temple teal), xd-ink--academy (西顶学院, black), xd-ink--lifestyle (西顶时光, white).

正在绘制 Ink

使用说明

Puts any block on one brand's ink: xd-ink--arts (西顶艺术, temple teal), xd-ink--academy (西顶学院, black), xd-ink--lifestyle (西顶时光, white).

The pages use these for the three bands, plates and dots. They read the ink-* and on-ink-* tokens, so a brand colour changed there reaches every page. 西顶时光 keeps a 1px ink hairline so white on white still reads.

Added in v1.7; renamed after the brands on 2026-11-19 (they were xd-ink--mei, --zhi, --li).

Lockup

Brand960 × 300

The mark with 西顶 and XIDING: stacked (mark over the names) or wide (mark beside them).

正在绘制 Lockup

使用说明

The mark with 西顶 and XIDING: stacked (mark over the names) or wide (mark beside them). Xiding.mark({ lockup: 'stacked' | 'horizontal', colorway, style }).

You provide the lockup and a colourway. The words are fixed.

  • 西顶 is wordmark-zh: Noto Serif SC Bold, opened 0.06em stacked and 0.04em wide. XIDING is wordmark-latin: Instrument Sans Medium, capitals, tracked 0.42em. Each line keeps its own face. XIDING is one word in capitals.
  • Stacked for square and tall spaces (signage, a title page). Wide for headers, footers and anything short.
  • The lockup needs both web fonts. In a file that will leave the browser (print, a deck for someone else's machine), convert the text to outlines first.
  • The mark can stand alone. The names appear with the mark.

正在绘制 LockupMotion

使用说明

The stacked lockup that opens the Introduction and the Official Site: 40 dots arrive one by one, then 西顶 fades in.

Classes xd-lockup xd-lockup--assemble; each circle carries --i, its order. It runs once, is still with reduced motion and in print. Keyframes are named xd-lockup-dot-in so they do not replace the mark's own xd-dot-in.

Mark

Brand960 × 212

The dot mark: 32 marks in 8 rows, 40 circles, mirrored about a centre axis.

正在绘制 Mark

使用说明

The dot mark: 32 marks in 8 rows, 40 circles, mirrored about a centre axis. Xiding.mark({ colorway, style }) returns it as SVG; the files in Logos are the same drawings.

You provide a colourway and a style.

  • Colourways — teal (white on brand-teal, the default and the first choice), ink (black on white), night (white on black), tealInk (teal on white). These four are the whole set.
  • Styles — dot is the logo. ring (the studio calls it Circle) and point are the same points drawn lighter: use them large, as a pattern or a watermark.
  • The eight approved pairs are in Xiding.PRESETS: teal dot, black dot, white dot, black circle, black point, white circle, teal circle on white, white point.
  • Clear space — keep mark-clear (140 of the mark's 1356 units, about a tenth of its height) free on every side. The exported files already include it.
  • Smallest size — 9.5 mm tall in print (the centred card back), 24 px on screen in dot. Below that the paired dots close up.
  • On a colour of your own, pass ink and ground: Xiding.mark({ ink: 'currentColor', ground: 'none' }).

Leave the mark as drawn: upright, whole, in one ink, on a flat field, with its clear space empty.

Pillars

Brand960 × 400

The three brands as three pillars standing on one base: 西顶艺术, 西顶学院 and 西顶时光.

正在绘制 Pillars

使用说明

The three brands as three pillars standing on one base: 西顶艺术, 西顶学院 and 西顶时光. Classes xd-pillars, xd-pillar, xd-pillar--arts, xd-pillar--academy, xd-pillar--lifestyle, xd-pillars__base, xd-pillars__motto, xd-pillars__sentence; the words come from Xiding.BRAND_DETAILS.

You provide nothing: the names, the words, the services and the lines are those of the public introduction.

  • Order is 西顶艺术, 西顶学院, 西顶时光. Each pillar carries the brand's word in the tagline (艺术, 教育, 生活方式) above its name.
  • Each pillar has its brand's ink: ink-arts (temple teal), ink-academy (black in light, white in dark), ink-lifestyle (open, with a 1px ink edge). The name is written on every pillar, so the inks tell the brands apart a second time.
  • Above each pillar sits its Latin line: XIDING ARTS, XIDING ACADEMY, XIDING LIFESTYLE.
  • The baseline is a 2px ink rule. Under it each pillar has its three services, then its three lines in muted, one to a line.
  • Use it once in a document, where the three brands are introduced. The same picture scales to signage and to a slide.

Scatter

Brand960 × 314

The mark whole in a flat field.

正在绘制 Scatter

使用说明

The mark whole in a flat field. Xiding.scatter({ width, height, x, y, size, field, fieldFill, ink, fieldInk, title, spread: 0 }) returns SVG: the mark at x, y and size, standing in field, its dots in fieldInk inside the field and in ink outside it.

Retired on 2026-11-18 by the owner: the dots no longer drift. Every composition keeps the mark whole, so call it with spread: 0 and no strays (the previews, Cover, Hero, the H5 screens and the showcase all do). The drift options (spread above 0, hold, angle, strays, seed, avoid, breathe) stay in the code so older pages still draw, but they are not used.

You provide the size of the drawing, where the mark stands and how tall, and the field it stands in.

  • The mark stays the mark. All 40 dots keep the measured geometry; nothing is carried off the mark.
  • Dots change ink at the field's edge. Inside field they are fieldInk (white on temple teal, teal on black); outside they take ink, by default the surrounding color. A mark placed across the field's edge is cropped by colour, not moved.
  • In the dark theme a #000000 field is lifted to surface with a line edge, so it does not vanish into the page.
  • Use it once per view, for covers, heroes, the first screen of a page and objects such as the membership card. With Xiding.assemble() the mark may assemble once, dot by dot; after that it holds still.

The wide layout is the studio's own card front. The stacked layout and the fitted "XIDING ACADEMY" line are additions made for the Academy: confirm them before print.

  • Proportion is 3:4. For print and engraving, keep the three inks as flat fields; the 西顶时光 plate is white with a 1px black edge.
  • Plates carry names. Directions and arrows are still to be designed with the site's floor plan.

总览

西顶 (Xiding) takes its name from 西顶庙 in Haidian, Beijing, a Ming temple known since 1712 as 广仁宫.

西顶文化 is the one short name Xiding goes by to the outside; in English it is Xiding. It is one team with three brands, 西顶艺术 (Xiding Arts), 西顶学院 (Xiding Academy) and 西顶时光 (Xiding Lifestyle): art, education and lifestyle (艺术 · 教育 · 生活方式). Membership runs across all three.

The identity is three inks and a field of dots: temple teal, black, white, and a mark of 40 circles. The three inks stand for the three brands.

Read 西顶是什么 for the full introduction and the names, and 文案 · Voice before writing a word for 西顶.

Voice

  • Say what is here and what happens here.
  • Every public line names two of four things: a place (处), a time (时), a person (人), an act (事). If the sentence could not be photographed, rewrite it.
  • Cut category words and self-praise: 文化生态, 平台, 体系, 赋能, 打造, 引领, 高端, 顶级, 唯一.
  • Cut these sentence patterns: 「不……只……」, 「不是……而是……」, 「至少……」, and "not X but Y" or "at least" in English. Keep the positive half of the sentence.
  • Cut slogan endings such as 「今天还开课」. A sentence stops on its fact.
  • Headlines state a fact or an act, in one or two lines, broken at a comma. A last line holds three characters or more.
  • Sentences end with a full stop. The system uses no exclamation marks and no emoji.
  • The name is 西顶 in Chinese and Xiding in English text: one word, capital X. The Latin line of a lockup is set in capitals: XIDING, XIDING ARTS, XIDING ACADEMY, XIDING LIFESTYLE. The site is 西顶庙.
  • 西顶文化 is Xiding, 西顶艺术 is Xiding Arts, 西顶学院 is Xiding Academy and 西顶时光 is Xiding Lifestyle.
  • Tone: restrained, concrete, sourced (克制、具体、有出处). Business results stay in case studies; every figure carries its source.
  • Interface text is plain sentence case, verb first: "Download SVG", "Show construction lines", "Leave empty to hide".

The three brands

  • Each brand has one ink: 西顶艺术 is ink-arts (temple teal), 西顶学院 is ink-academy (black), 西顶时光 is ink-lifestyle (white, drawn with an ink hairline). Text on them is on-ink-arts, on-ink-academy, on-ink-lifestyle. Colour here tells the brands apart; the brand's name is written beside it every time.
  • Use Xiding.BRAND_DETAILS for each brand's id (also its ink), names, its word in the tagline (艺术, 教育, 生活方式), field, services and lines, and Xiding.TAGLINE for 艺术 · 教育 · 生活方式.
  • The three brands may stand as three pillars on one base: use the Pillars component for it, and PillarCard for slice titles and quote cards.
  • Retired on 2026-11-19: the three lines of work under the brands, the three pillars they stood on and the value line made of their mottos.

Colour

  • Three brand inks stay the same in both themes: brand-teal (Temple teal), brand-black, brand-white. They are the whole brand palette.
  • Four colourways for the mark and for any brand field: white on brand-teal (first choice), black on white, white on black, teal on white.
  • Pages sit on paper, panels and cards on surface, text in ink, secondary text in muted, hairlines in line.
  • Teal as text is teal-text. teal is for shapes and for type at 24px and above.
  • brand-black type may sit on brand-teal (5.8:1) where the teal is a dot or a button: a chosen day, the one teal action dot on a screen, the teal call to act. Text on a teal field stays brand-white.
  • The mark and large type sit on brand-teal in brand-white. Small text goes on paper, surface, white or black.
  • Keyboard focus is a solid 2px focus outline, offset 3px.
  • guide-trim and guide-safe are for print proofs.

Type

  • Songti for what is said aloud, sans for what is read. --font-serif is Noto Serif SC (500, 600, 700); --font-sans is Instrument Sans (400, 500, 600). Both are hosted on Google Fonts: load them with a stylesheet link, and convert lockups to outlines before print.
  • 西顶 is set in wordmark-zh; XIDING in wordmark-latin, capitals tracked 0.42em. Sub-brand names are brand-row, tracked 0.28em.
  • One idea per screen: large type and shapes first, few notes, generous empty space.
  • One hero or display line per view. Section headings are title. Running text is body; the line under a title is lede in muted.
  • Labels are label, buttons ui, hints and captions caption in muted, SVG and point data code.
  • Chinese text is opened with letter-spacing. A two-character personal name on a card is opened to the width of three.
  • Figures in tables and readouts use tabular numerals.

The mark

  • Use the files in Logos, or Xiding.mark(). The point data is in assets/Logos/xiding-mark-points-extracted.json; draw from it and leave the mark as it is.
  • dot is the logo. ring and point are for large, quiet uses: a pattern, a watermark, a cover.
  • Keep mark-clear free on every side. Smallest size: 9.5 mm tall in print, 24px on screen.
  • Lockups: mark alone, stacked, or wide. A sub-brand is named on the brand row of the master lockup, under the one mark.
  • Line type up with the dots. In the wide lockup 西顶 spans dot rows B to E, the Latin line rests on row G and the brand row on row H.
  • Names or facts on one line are joined by the pair dot (two overlapping dots).

自在 · The art layer

Covers, heroes and the first screen of every page are composed like a hanging scroll, not a form.

  • Hang the words. Titles and the tagline may be set vertically (xd-vert, right to left): page titles at 88px against the right edge, the tagline in three columns. Latin lines run vertically beside them in capitals, tracked 0.42em (xd-vert--latin), and never carry Chinese characters.
  • Leave the space empty. A composition holds one field, one block of words and the mark. Nothing fills the rest.
  • Keep the mark whole. In its field the mark stands as drawn, all 40 dots in place, drawn large and cropped by the field's edge where the layout wants it. Dots never drift out of the mark or scatter across the paper (decided by the owner on 2026-11-18): call Xiding.scatter() with spread: 0 and no strays, or use Xiding.mark().
  • Brands as stones. On a first screen the three brands may stand as three dots of three sizes, set loosely like stones in a courtyard, each with its name hung beside it (xd-stones).
  • Lists cascade. Under a vertical heading, entries sit in a loose column, every other one stepped in (xd-loose, xd-note); the action is a word ending on the pair dot (xd-act).
  • Forms, rows of facts and buttons stay plain and level: the art is in the composition, never in the controls.

Layout, space and edges

  • Spacing steps are space-8, space-12, space-16, space-20, space-24, space-40, space-72. Panels pad space-20; tiles sit space-12 apart; sections sit space-40 to space-72 apart.
  • Corners are nearly square: radius-sm on controls, radius-md on panels, tiles and tables. radius-full is for dots and swatches.
  • Edges are 1px line hairlines. The interface is flat. shadow-card and shadow-thumb lift a printed card in a mockup.
  • Selection is shown by an ink fill or an ink border.
  • Compose in flat rectangular fields of teal, black and white, like the colourway tiles. One field per view carries the mark.
  • On screens, fields run edge to edge. The mark in a field is drawn large (about 400px tall on a 375px screen) and cropped by the field's edge, clear of the headline. Lists are ruled rows on the page, not boxed cards.

Imagery

  • The system ships without photographs. When they arrive, they show the real site: its gate, halls and courtyards, straight on, in daylight, with people doing something.
  • Guest portraits for the programme are shot in the same room, from the same camera position, in the same light, so every guest belongs to one series.
  • The root is 广仁宫 and the expression is contemporary. Leave out imitation-antique styling.
  • Leave out stock pictures of tea, incense, hands and calligraphy brushes. Leave out 祥云, 回纹, 水墨晕染, 朱红描金, seals, lanterns and roof silhouettes. Leave out glow, particles and gradients.
  • The mark sits on a flat field beside a photograph.

Iconography

  • The dot is the pictogram. The system has no icon set and no emoji.
  • Brand tags are round dots of the brand's ink. On screens, a row's action is a 56px dot carrying a one-word verb (报名, 预约); a call to act ends on the pair dot.
  • Contact lines use one-letter labels (M, E, W, A) in teal-text.
  • Colour choices are shown with an xd-swatch dot beside the colour's name.

Motion

  • The mark may assemble once, dot by dot, when it first appears: Xiding.assemble(el) staggers the dots row by row, top first. Dots respond to a pointer with a 0.18s ease-out scale.
  • Fields change colour over 0.35s; controls over 0.15s.
  • After it has assembled the mark holds still. Dots do not drift or breathe.
  • With reduced motion set, everything appears in place.

Using the files

  • components/bundle.js is one classic script that sets window.Xiding. It needs no framework. Xiding.mark(), Xiding.subBrand(), Xiding.brandRow() and Xiding.card() return strings of SVG or HTML: set them as innerHTML or save them as files. Types are in components/index.d.ts; the TypeScript source is components/src/xiding.ts.
  • components/bundle.css holds the xd- classes for the controls, the brand row and the hero. It reads the token variables, so load the tokens first.
  • Xiding.kit() lists every generated asset as a drawing; Xiding.toSVG(art) and Xiding.toPNG(art) turn one into a file. The AssetKit page draws the whole kit live and saves files from it. components/src/build-assets.ts writes the same kit to disk for outlining.
  • Assets holds the files: Logos (the mark, avatars, PNG), Wordmarks (names), Pillars (the three brands as pillars, and their plates), Intro (the architecture and four-step diagrams), Cards (the card front) and Reference (links.json).
  • The H5 components are six mobile screens at 375px that follow the architecture: 首页, 会员, 预约空间, 学院, 展览, 全年日历. Mobile measures are the h5-* tokens; mobile type is the H5 group.
  • 参考 · References keeps Xiding's links, the benchmarks, the sources for the facts and the system's own measured figures.
  • Each component's README says what you provide and when to use it.

Intentional additions

These were added to the mark studio's inventory so XIDING ACADEMY material can be made from this system:

  • The hero type style and the Hero layout.
  • The six H5 screens and their tokens. Sample sessions on them are marked 示例.
  • VideoCover, Subtitle, Slide, DoorPlate and SceneMenu: the layouts the IP document lists as still to be specified, drawn with the existing inks and type.
  • The brand inks: one identifying colour per brand and a neutral base; this system assigns the three existing inks and uses paper as the base (until 2026-11-19 they were the three pillar inks).
  • The stacked sub-brand lockup and the fitted "XIDING ACADEMY" Latin line in SubBrand.
  • Button hover in teal-text, so the label holds 4.5:1.
  • v1.8: the source VI of 西頂廣仁宮 (brand/xiding-guangren-vi/, 品牌形象-5): its six swatches as vi-* tokens, its 13 logo files as the VI asset group, and its nameplate as TempleSign. The brand teal is an open decision (see 尚未统一 · Open decisions).
  • v1.7: the page kit the five live Xiding pages share (Ink, LockupMotion, Photo, Whisper, Export, Go, Lang, FieldBlock, Ecosystem), Cormorant Garamond figures (--font-figure), CJK sans fallbacks, and font swaps for <html lang="en"> and lang="zh-Hant". The full-bleed field is .xd-fieldblock--bleed; .xd-field is the form Field's alone.
  • 2026-11-18: the mark stays whole. The drifting, scattered dots of v1.6 are retired from every composition (Cover, Hero, the H5 screens, the showcase); scatter() keeps its options for compatibility, and every composition calls it with spread: 0.
  • The art layer (v1.6): vertical type, Xiding.scatter() with hold, avoid and breathing, the stones, the loose list, the floating tab bar, the held membership card, and the Cover and Hero recomposed on it.
  • The expressive mobile layer (v1.5): full-bleed fields with the cropped mark, the brand band, ruled numbered lists, action dots, round brand dots, the black tab bar, brand-black on brand-teal for dots and buttons, and Xiding.assemble(). No hue was added.

西顶是什么

西顶取名自北京海淀的西顶庙，清代称广仁宫。

西顶文化是西顶对外统一的简称：艺术 · 教育 · 生活方式。西顶文化是一套班子，旗下设立三大业务品牌：西顶艺术、西顶学院、西顶时光。会员体系贯穿三个牌子。

三个牌子

牌子英文标识拉丁文领域做什么三句话
西顶艺术Xiding ArtsXIDING ARTS艺术 / 文化艺术策展、品牌共创、私享定制以艺术连接文化，以创意赋能品牌，以体验创造价值。
西顶学院Xiding AcademyXIDING ACADEMY教育 / 学习课程研修、战略咨询、人才发展以教育启发认知，以咨询推动变革，以人才驱动未来。
西顶时光Xiding LifestyleXIDING LIFESTYLE生活方式 / 会员会员生活、品质社交、精致体验以时光沉淀价值，以品味连接彼此，以社群丰富生活。

对外的介绍页：https://claude.ai/artifact/EmhEzgmXoCQuTV1GL5VRHV（西顶文化｜艺术 · 教育 · 生活方式，草稿，图片待替换）。

根在广仁宫。

三步

  1. 人和内容带来艺术家和行业专家。
  2. 三个牌子把专家的能力交付给会员和合作伙伴。
  3. 智能体之间完成匹配、预约与分账，收益回到出力的人手里。

底层：每人一个智能体

会员、专家、艺术家、空间和伙伴各有一个智能体，彼此对接需求、预约场景、确认交付并自动分账。西顶自己跑在这套系统上，它是西顶学院咨询现成的样板。

品牌架构与命名

品牌名用拼音 Xiding，后面的描述词翻成英文。西顶文化、西顶艺术、西顶学院、西顶时光的英文名已定；其余是建议，待定稿。

层级中文英文角色
文化根源广仁宫Guangren Palace价值观来源，留在商业品牌之外
整体西顶文化Xiding对外统一的简称，整体与签约主体
牌子西顶艺术Xiding Arts艺术：策展、品牌共创、私享定制
牌子西顶学院Xiding Academy教育：课程研修、战略咨询、人才发展
牌子西顶时光Xiding Lifestyle生活方式：会员生活、品质社交、精致体验
产品线知礼待定零售，做聚焦品类
伙伴OPC GlobalOPC Global伙伴，独立信用
底层智能体系统（A2A）待定匹配、预约、交付与分账

命名规则：

  • Xiding 写成一个词，首字母大写。标识里的拉丁文一行全大写：XIDING、XIDING ARTS、XIDING ACADEMY、XIDING LIFESTYLE。
  • 西顶学院用 Academy。Xiding Institute 留给将来的研究机构。
  • 公众号、物料与对外文件上的中英文名保持一致。

场景

每个场景都回答一个问题：它如何服务先行者。

类别场景作用
西顶艺术古琴、艺术鉴赏、策展养品味
西顶学院咨询、培训、落地陪跑对接解决问题
西顶时光生日、下午茶、私宴经营关系
担当心理辅导、教练养心力

会员为邀请制。供给端同一标准：邀请加审核。

文案 · Voice

语气：克制、具体、有出处。

西顶的文案写这里有什么、发生什么。

Xiding copy is restrained, concrete and sourced. It says what is here and what happens here.

一个简称、一个主问

层级内容状态
简称西顶文化：艺术 · 教育 · 生活方式已定
主问AI 时代，什么样的人能驾驭 AI？已有
主问（标题用）谁能驾驭 AI？建议

一条规矩：处、时、人、事

每一句对外的话，写进四样里的两样。

是什么例
处 Place一个去得了的地方西顶路、山门、殿里、院子
时 Time一个查得到的时间明代、康熙五十一年、周四下午
人 Person一个叫得出名字的人谁讲、谁来、谁做的
事 Act一个做得出的动作挑出对的方案、排先后、引荐、听琴

检验：这句话拍得成一张照片吗？拍得成，留下；拍不成，重写。

词表 Word list

用换掉原因
先行者新领导者、大佬、精英对象包括独自做事的人
品味与取舍艺术修养读成一种能力，离素质教育远一些
重心转移颠覆、全新能力经得起内行追问
可信关系人脉、资源讲的是信任
邀请制免费、福利门槛本身就是价值
落地陪跑OPC、FDE 等缩写连用客户买的是结果
主张研究表明理论尚待实证

俗套清单 Words to cut

俗套为什么没感觉换成
西顶是一个文化生态是一个分类，读的人看不到画面一套班子，三个牌子：西顶艺术、西顶学院、西顶时光
广结善缘，仁勇如一拆名字凑出的八个字，挂在哪座庙里都成立西顶文化：艺术 · 教育 · 生活方式
生态、生态圈、生态赋能、专家生态、生态伙伴抽象，谁在里面看不出来点名：会员、专家、艺术家、空间、伙伴
闭环、矩阵、体系、平台、综合体是结构图上的词说步骤：一二三四
赋能、链接、打造、引领、助力、聚焦、深耕动词缺主语，缺对象谁，带谁，做什么：请艺术家带伙伴练品味与取舍
建立认知、提升素养结果看不见写可观察的行为：三个方案里选出最优，并讲清理由
AI 时代（当开头用）人人都这样开头直接问：谁能驾驭 AI？
A2A、OPC、FDE（连着用）是缩写，读的人看不到结果每人一个智能体，对接需求、预约、确认交付、分账
传承与创新、古今交融、传统与当代并存放在哪里都成立根在广仁宫，表达是当代的
高端、顶级、稀缺、圈层、唯一、最好的自夸，读的人无从验证一个数字或一个名字
生活方式、Lifestyle哪个品牌都在用写日历上的事：古琴、鉴赏、下午茶、私宴
流量、金句、记忆点是运营的行话对内可用，对外换成事实
今天还开课、等你来、未完待续口号腔的收尾，俗气删掉，句子停在事实上
hub, ecosystem, platform, empower, curated, immersiveThe same, in EnglishName who is there and what they do

句式清单 Sentence patterns to cut

  • 「不……只……」「不是……而是……」「不止于……」「说……不说……」「讲……不讲……」。
  • 「至少……」「起码……」。
  • 「让……成为……」。
  • 四字词排比连用；感叹号；引号里的「新」字（「新」中式、「新」国潮）。
  • In English: "not X but Y", "more than just", "at least".

改法：把否定的半句删掉，留下肯定的半句，再补上处、时、人、事。

标题公式 Titles

  • 栏目总题：谁能驾驭 AI？听 XX 讲艺术、教育、生活方式
  • 单期标题：XX：一个具体的取舍或决定。例如「XX：我为什么否掉了 AI 给的前三个方案」
  • 切片标题：牌子名加一句话。例如「西顶时光｜谁在你最难的时候愿意信你」

标题里用嘉宾名字，先取得对方的书面确认。

每期四问 The four questions

对应问题
西顶艺术最近一次你否掉 AI 给的方案，凭的是什么？
西顶学院你怎么把一个团队的活装进一个人的工作流？
西顶时光谁是你的贵人？这段关系你是怎么经营的？
担当最难的一次决定是什么？你承担了什么？

红线 Red lines

  • 承诺经营结果的句子，删掉。利润、增长留在案例里讲。
  • 数据写出处。未核实的数据和二手研究，删掉。
  • 先讲主张，再讲产品，两段分开。
  • 嘉宾姓名与肖像的使用以书面授权为准。

可用的事实 Facts to draw from

写之前先从这里取，一句用一条。年份付印前对照庙内碑记核一遍。

  • 西顶庙，明代始建，1518 年。到 2026 年，五百零八年。
  • 北京“五顶”之一，西边的这一座，供奉碧霞元君。
  • 清康熙五十一年（1712）更名广仁宫。
  • 北京市海淀区曙光街道西顶路西顶庙。
  • 占地约 7,000 ㎡。

写法 Mechanics

  • 名字：中文写西顶。英文正文写 Xiding，一个词，首字母大写。标识里的拉丁文一行全大写：XIDING。场地叫西顶庙。
  • 标题：说一件事实、一个动作或一个问题，两行以内，在逗号处断行，行末留足三个字。
  • 版面：一屏一个观点，大字和图形优先，注释少。
  • 标点：中文用全角；句子用句号收尾；全文无感叹号、无表情符号。
  • 数字：阿拉伯数字加单位，「约 7,000 ㎡」「90 × 54 mm」；中文与数字、拉丁字母之间空一格。
  • 标识和版面里并列的两个名字之间，用双点（pair dot）。切片标题的纯文字里用「｜」。
  • 人：先中文名，后拼音，职务中英并列：「李四 Li Si　院长 Dean」。
  • English: short declaratives, present tense, concrete nouns, sentence case.

尚未统一 · Open decisions

These differences between the pages and this system were left as they are, for the owner to decide.

  • Member Home redefines eight components locally — xd-item, xd-list, xd-cta, xd-memcard, xd-rows, xd-monthhead, xd-event, xd-tag — as bordered cards on surface and a teal membership card, where this system has ruled rows and a black card.
  • Xiding App uses its own ap-* kit: 18–24px radii, pill buttons, blur bars and chips, against this system's 3–4px corners.
  • Dot (settled 2026-11-18): the shared page kit's xd-dot (src/shared/base.css) is round again, as this system has it. The member page that drew its pillar tags with it is developed in a separate repository, which takes the same fix.
  • Brand teal: the source VI's teal is #559895 (vi-teal); this system's brand-teal is #628F8A. One of them should become the brand's teal.
  • VI palette: red, sand, mauve grey, ivory and charcoal are tokens now but no component uses them; the system still has three inks.
  • QR: pages draw xd-qr per link at build time; it is not a component here.

Recorded by the v1.7 and v1.8 migrations; each stays open until the owner decides.

对标 Benchmarks

三个对标，各看一件事。这份名单是起点，换成你们自己选定的对象即可。

对标看什么西顶可以取的留意
Aspen Executive Seminar学院的形式每期 15 到 20 人，住下来七天，围着固定文本由主持人带着谈，1950 年办到现在。固定的框架加小班，同每期四问、嘉宾轮换是一个路数它的文本是两千年的经典；西顶的材料是嘉宾自己的取舍与决定
MIT Media Lab 标识（Pentagram，2014），品牌规范标识与子品牌一张 7×7 的网格生成主标识和 23 个研究组的标识；子标识的留白、并排间距都写成规则。西顶的点阵标识加品牌行是同一个思路它为每个组另画一个标识；西顶的牌子和板块共用一个标识，名字写在品牌行上
Temple 东景缘（智珠寺），访谈古寺新用明代寺院，2007 年起按修旧如旧修缮，如今办展览、演出和餐饮。老建筑原样留着，里面的表达是当代的2014 年因“寺庙里的会所”受到舆论批评。西顶写邀请制时，把公众能来的时间和内容一并写清楚
